answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 9 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 71 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The nadir of the design is public, the lantern of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the dawn of honest work is what finally pays.
